notes.title: The Feast for Crows has Begun!
notes.content:
[i]A lull of silence passed over this blood-filled land as yet another battle has ended in this ceaseless war. A war that has gone on for so long that most do not remember how it began. The corpses were picked clean by the murder of crows that descended in the aftermath. It is time for them to move onto the next battlefield, as the Feast for Crows has long since begun![/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1416391/A_Game_Of_Thrones__A_Feast_For_Crows/

A Feast for Crows has now officially launched. Take part in the war for the Iron Throne as it reaches its pinnacle phase. While the Great Houses of Lannister and Baratheon are embroiled in a never-ending fight for King's Landing, the Starks attempt to secure a complete dominion over the North. At the same time, House Arryn manoeuvres itself to prepare its grand entrance into the pit. All will fall against those who stands as High as Honor.

The war has grown, and the battlefield has continued to change. With the release of A Feast for Crows DLC, you will be able to control one of four Houses to decide the outcome in this drastically different scenario. Faster and focused on just a part of Westeros, this game mode also introduces House Arryn, their 7 unique House cards, updated rules and a new victory condition: objective points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/7d91c1a924b30644626d60198c88009a03cd0297.jpg[/img]

Each House comes with its own unique Objective, which they will fight endlessly to achieve. You will also draw Secret Objectives from a pool of 28 cards, requiring you to adjust your tactics in order to gather the points you require to achieve victory. Holding castles and lands might not always be the best move now, and diplomacy is more important than ever… and so is betrayal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/9a80858b13ea00cec6e8e1af7c41ba95bf0cba60.jpg[/img]

Are you and the members of your House ready to see the epitome of the battle for the Iron Throne take place? Then prepare yourselves and purchase A Feast for Crows, available now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1416391/A_Game_Of_Thrones__A_Feast_For_Crows/

[h2]Bugfixing[/h2]

In addition to the DLC release, several issues affecting the base game have been resolved. 
[list]
[*] Various online desynchronization issues have been resolved.
[*] Balon Greyjoy's effect cancels card strength adding effect on top of the base strength.
[*] Issue with the supply counting when doing a specific move is now fixed.
[*] Challenge: Leaving Kings Landing doesn't ask you to leave power behind is now fixed.
[*] Edge case when user is given an Order select prompt when selecting areas when they have no more Orders left to place is now fixed.
[*] Tutorial: Opponent Details Screen is not disabled while Player Detail Screen is, this is now fixed.
[*] Wildfire rule is not consistent between languages in Lannister challenge 3, this is now fixed.
[*] Some minor localization issues have been fixed.
[/list]


[i]Stay tuned for more news on A Game of Thrones! [/i]

notes.title: Our Journey: From Launch until now
notes.content:
Greetings citizens of Westeros!

It has been a wild 10 months since the release of A Game of Thrones: The Board Game - Digital Edition. We have released the game, as well as the A Dance with Dragons DLC, and are even working on more content to come! We wanted to take a few moments to thank all of our loyal fans and users who have been helping us to squash bugs, and so much more. I won't name you all here, but you know who you are!

Discover our journey through Westeros to get here:
[list]
[*] October 06 - A Game of Thrones: The Board Game - Digital Edition releases on Steam.
[*] October 13 - Steam Patch: Bug fixes and Live Game enabled by default
[*] October 28 - Steam Patch: Bug fixes and updates
[*] November 23 - Steam Patch: Multiple small bug fixes and changes
[*] January 19 - Steam patch & maintenance
[*] April 07 - Mobile version & A Dance with Dragons DLC Released, alongside a number of bug fixes
[*] June 22 - Patch Release, Steam & mobile: Various bug fixes and large scale server updates
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1075190/discussions/0/5197701062338226591/]July 20[/url] - Patch Release, Steam & mobile: Additional bug fixes, resolving remaining stability issues[/list]
In addition to the above changes, we have made a slew of server-side and client changes that did not require updates. These efforts we hope have made the game more enjoyable for everyone and we want to assure you that we are working on more content for the future!

Be sure to view the patch notes for our latest patch here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1075190/discussions/0/5197701062338226591/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/bc4b4e9cf7514a3755fe598b14b5fdf272ff908f.png[/img]

We highly recommend that you join us on our Facebook Page to follow us regarding upcoming content and news so that you might stay as up to date as possible!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/AGoTBGDigital/

Thank you again to everyone who makes this community special by offering us feedback, bug reports and details about your play experience

notes.title: The King's Proclamation: New Features and repairs to the kingdom!
notes.content:
Greetings to the great Houses of Westeros.

The king has descended from his throne and has deemed fit to make a number of changes to his kingdom! Read on to learn all about the changes and new features that have been released.

We are proud to announce that these features and changes should optimize the play for a large number of players; reducing desynchronizations and bugs encountered, as well as helping to handle users who are intentionally holding up a match.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/bc4b4e9cf7514a3755fe598b14b5fdf272ff908f.png[/img]

[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*]A new Turn timer feature has been implemented. You can enable this feature when creating your match and it will require each action to be made within a specific duration. This is intended to assist with users going AFK, or attempting to obstruct a match from progressing.
[list][*]This is a timer that is active only in "Live Games" that replaces the old functionality to maintain more active matches. Players have 90 seconds to take an action and 180 seconds in the planning phase. Players that exceed this timer or are offline will have their actions made by an AI. Exceeding this timer twice in a tow will cause a player to be permanently replaced by an AI.[/list]
[*]Live games are now off by default. There is now a pop-up that will explain the "Live-game" feature when you create a match to ensure you set all options correctly.
[/list]

[h1]Desynchronization Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Changes and improvements have been implemented to the server to minimize desynchronization complications reported previously.
[*]Users should now see far fewer issues with stability and desynchronization as a result, if not completely eliminated in most cases.[list][*]Do note a small issue with inter-device compatibility is still causing desynchronization. Older device clocks can clash with newer ones, resulting in desynchronization. We are actively working on this and will implement a fix as soon as possible.[/list][/list]

[h1]General Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Robb Stark's card ability will now properly trigger if you are defending.
[*]Power tokens are no longer removed from an area when an opposing force moves into an area with units already in it.
[*]A softlock will no longer occur when leaving a port and directly entering combat.
[*]Track Bidding tie-breaking History entries will now display properly.
[*]Crow Killers will not properly force players to remove knights when they have no footmen.
[*]Mustering Limit warnings will now appear as an info prompt, rather than as a pop-up message.
[*]The Queen of Thorns' ability now works on ports for areas you attack.
[/list]

[h1]A Dance with Dragons Fixes: [/h1]
[list]
[*]Mance Rayder now correctly sets combat strength to 0 when the Wildling Track is at 0.
[*]Stannis Baratheon now correctly removes adjacent Support orders
[*]Melisandre now correctly offers you the choice to use her ability or not.
[/list]

[h1]Multiplayer Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]When you resign a match you will no longer see chat messages from it.
[*]If you are invited to a friend match while not online and later accept, you will now be able to correctly select the house you want to play.
[*]"Your Turn" text from lobbies no longer displays incorrectly inside the match.
[*]"Live Game" was visually disabled on fresh installs when creating lobbies, but was functionally enabled. This has now been fixed.
[*]If a Vassal's city is taken, the player controlling that Vassal can now correctly attack that location in the same turn.
[*]Freidn's game invitations will now properly display in the lobby.
[/list]

[h1]Mobile Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Bridges are now correctly visible on the mobile playmat.
[*]Tooltips often appeared under the user's finger. This has been fixed.
[*]UI in front-end menus is no longer hard to read with touch-and-hold input. 
[/list]

[h1]Challenges Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Reconnecting to a "Coastal Assault" match no longer prevents the user from completing the match.
[*]The Assemble the Fleet challenge now receives the correct progress when taking control of White Harbor.
[/list]

notes.title: Wars never end, and the battle for the Iron Throne has just begun!
notes.content:
Greeting to all those who covet the Iron Throne!

It has been one month since A Game of Thrones: The Board Game - Digital Edition was released. We have remained, unbowed, unbent and unbroken in the face of the battles that came and have fought to ensure that the experience of all players is the best it can be. We want to thank every player that has taken a part in the Game of Thrones for your tireless passion, feedback and bug reports to help us make this the best game it possibly can be!

Over the past month we have released a number of new features and fixed a number of bugs that were causing issues for players, thanks to all of your feedback. Take a few moments to review all of the changes that we have made below, to improve the experience of all users:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/bc4b4e9cf7514a3755fe598b14b5fdf272ff908f.png[/img]
[u][b][h1]New Features & Implementations[/h1][/b][/u][list][*]Live Game Mode - A feature that is enabled by the game host. It ensures that when a player leaves the match they are immediately replaced by a bot for the interim of their absence. This feature provides users with a more syncronous play experience.
[*]Player clock visibility - We made additional changes to allow users to see the time left on all user's player clocks. This provides more visibility into the state of other player's remaining time.
[*]Visual feedback on Bot replacement - Some users were not aware of when a user was replaced with a bot. To help users identify this switch, a new visual feedback for this was added.
[*] Passwords removed for friend matches - As invites were required for friend matches, the password requirement was removed to meet player demands.
[*] Password no longer required after joining match - Once a match with a password is joined, you no longer require to enter it again at a later point. This was to reduce input requirements on players and hasten reconnections to matches.
[*]All players can now see the time remaining on other's player clocks 
[*]A new visual feedback has been added for when a player is replaced by a bot[/list]

[u][b][h1]Bug fixes[/h1][/b][/u][list][*] Fixed an issue causing the game to soft-lock upon a player forfeiture.
[*]Cards from a player's hand will no longer get stuck in the middle of your screen.
[*]Ports can now be appropriately raided by adjascent territories.
[*]You will now receive an additional power token when a ship occupies a castle's port.
[*]Sir Rodrik spelling error has now been corrected.
[*]You can now select ships in port for Wildling card effects that require units to be destroyed
[*]Patchface card interactions with other cards, such as Roose Bolton, have been fixed
[*] Patchface now resolves correctly when the opponent has no cards in hand.
[*]The Direwolf card being played if a user has no more cards to play will no longer cause a user to get all 7 cards back to their hand.
[*]Betting on tracks no longer appears as "?/X" where X could be a random number for some users. This will now only display as "?"
[*]Soft lock - If someone loses all their cards outside of combat, they have none when next combat begins. Cards should now be correctly returned.
[*]Boats are now properly destroyed when losing an area with a port attached.
[*]Territories on land are no longer capable of supporting the sea in some edge cases.
[*]A Vassal using Beric Dondarrion will no longer soft lock if the only participating unit was a Garrison.
[*]If a player leaves during their turn and an AI takes over, the game will no longer soft lock.
[*]Order tokens that mysteriously changed when revealed should no longer change.
[*]Lannister should now be able to properly retreat to Lannisport from Golden Sound when losing combat.
[*] You no longer need to use a power token to keep your home castle if it is reclaimed after losing it.
[*] A siege engine lost as a result of combat is no longer counted amongst the units to destroy by card effects.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/bc4b4e9cf7514a3755fe598b14b5fdf272ff908f.png[/img]
[u][b][h1]Looking to the future[/h1][/b][/u]
As we move into the future of A Game of Thrones: The Board Game - Digital Edition more changes will come on raven wings, we want to assure you that we remain committed to improving the game to provide you with the best play experience possible. We will continue to deploy new patches and improvements, and keep you up to date with any potential new content coming down the line!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1075190/

[u][b][h1]Basic Tips[/h1][/b][/u][olist][*][h3]Play the Tutorial[/h3]
A 3-step tutorial is available for any new players to A Game of Thrones: The Board Game - Digital Edition. Each of these three tutorials will focus on a core aspect of the game: Ordering your troops, resource management, Mustering, Events as well as the alliance gameplay features!
[*][h3]Finish the Digital Exclusive Challenges[/h3]
Set during the War of the Five Kings, the ten digital exclusive challenge missions will put the player in the role of some of the Great Houses after the death of King Robert Baratheon. With unique set ups and winning conditions, these missions will provide you with the perfect training in more advanced mechanics of the game to help you master the core gameplay of each house![/olist]

[u][b][h1]Pro Tips - Strategies per Great House[/h1]
[h2]House Lannister - "Hear me roar"[/h2][/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/9d81c59caad49dff36ba25628d204367943312e1.png[/img]
The Lannisters start the game surrounded by foes, but consequently they are all within your reach. Strike alliances with those willing and advance slowly, but surely... Make them hear your roar as you claim territories and grow your strength.

The Lannisters face [b]early challenges[/b], being surrounded by many enemies, yet they do have the [b]tools needed to succeed[/b].

[u][h3]Early Game Strategy:[/h3][/u][list][*]Take the Sunset Sea, whilst you reinforce the Golden Sound with ships to push the Greyjoy away from you.
[*][b]Use the Messenger Raven for riskier plays[/b], as you will be able to react to your opponents strategies.
[*]Take the Searoad Marches with only a footman to avoid appearing too aggressive towards House Tyrell.[/list]
[u][h3]Mid-Game strategy:[/h3][/u][list][*]Use support from the Golden Sound and raid from Sunset Sea to control the area
[*]Take Flint's Finger and push eastward using your amle supplies
[*]Negotiate with the Stark to [b]take down the Greyjoy[/b][/list]
[u][h3]Late-Game strategy:[/h3][/u][list][*][b]Betray the Stark[/b] when the opportunity presents itself!
[*]Use feints to deceive the Baratheon as to where you will attack.
[*]Take Highgarden if the Martell is keeping Tyrell busy.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/bc4b4e9cf7514a3755fe598b14b5fdf272ff908f.png[/img]
[h2]House Stark - "Winter is Coming"[/h2][/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/692c3cebc078cb4bede60d3d8c16982fc498ca58.png[/img]
You are the Warden of the North, the shield of your people. As such you will need to conquer and hold vital chokepoints leading to your lands.Winter is coming, and you with it!

The Starks benefit from a [b]defensible start[/b] and are good at playing around spreading their [b]influence[/b].

[u][h3]Early Game Strategy:[/h3][/u][list][*]Take Moat Caillin and brace yourself for the [b]Greyjoy and lannister Assaults[/b].
[*]Take the surrounding Supplies to compensate for your start.
[*]Start recruiting troops in Winterfell for the war to come.[/list]
[u][h3]Mid-Game strategy:[/h3][/u][list][*]You cannot defeat the Baratheon or Greyjoy on the seas, but you can be a risky tarket. Take control of the Narrow Sea and threaten the Seagard to [b]dissuade any invasions[/b].
[*]Use your influence advantage to outbid your opponents during events or on the influence track.
[*]If the Greyjoy is too big of a threat, you can always team up with the Lannisters.[/list]
[u][h3]Late-Game strategy:[/h3][/u][list][*]You probably will not be able to grab seven castles, but you can [b]aim for the Eyrie[/b].
[*]Take the Seagard and Flint's Finger.
[*]Advance towards Riverrun to win by castle Majority.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/bc4b4e9cf7514a3755fe598b14b5fdf272ff908f.png[/img]
[h2]House Greyjoy - "We do not sow"[/h2][/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/6aa9ff253b51edd12c50c40113d5b89ac8e385d1.png[/img]
True sea raiders, the Greyjoy are most powerful at sea. Use your uncontested navy to hide your true intentions and threaten wider areas. Choose one target and crush them. You will not be able to recruit enough troops for a war on two fronts. You do not sow, for they will pay the iron price.

As an [b]aggressive [/b]House, the Greyjoys will be relying on an [b]early rush[/b] and sea control.

[u][h3]Early Game Strategy:[/h3][/u][list][*]You are the strongest in the early game with the Valyrian Sword token, [b]don't be afraid to pick a fight[/b].
[*]If you choose to go against the Stark, try to come to an agreement with the Lannisters to delay their inevitable backstabbing. Start heading towards Moat Callin whilst taking the Bay of Ice.
[*]If you choose to fight the Lannisters instead,  take Riverrun and Seagard to accumulate power tokens as to defned your Valyrian Sword. Make a move on Lannisport as soon as you are strong enough![/list]
[u][h3]Mid-Game strategy:[/h3][/u][list][*]Whoever you chose to attack, you now need to [b]burn their capital down [/b]and sieze as many castles as you can!
[*]As you will probably be the most aggressive player, prepare to face a coalition by increasing your defenses and striking a deal with the Martell.[/list]
[u][h3]Late-Game strategy:[/h3][/u][list][*]With one of your neighbors dealt with, turn your attention toward the other. They will kindly provide you with the castles you require for victory!
[*]Do not be afraid to [b]use your superior mobility[/b] to snatch up vulnerable castles around the map.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/bc4b4e9cf7514a3755fe598b14b5fdf272ff908f.png[/img]
[h2]House Baratheon - "Ours is the fury"[/h2][/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/0c76b59d2e8097a3fcc0701f7dc734c12996a8c2.png[/img]
As the true heir to the Iron Throne, you start close to King's Landing. Use your navy in support as to ensure that none will challenge your might. Be wary though, as you will need to control Blackwater to field a respectable army. Once you have landed, fury will be yours!

The Baratheons have [b]many opportunities [/b]as a very [b]versatile [/b]House.

[u][h3]Early Game Strategy:[/h3][/u][list][*]Use your three movement orders to take control of King's Landing and the areas around it.
[*]Aim for Blackwater and the Reach, but keep some forces back to gain the much-needed Power tokens.
[*]Be sure to [b]control the sea for protection [/b]and future opportunities.[/list]
[u][h3]Mid-Game strategy:[/h3][/u][list][*]Both the Stark and Martell are prime targets for a naval invasion, but be wary of the card "Doran Martell". It may be used to throw you off form an Influence track. Counter it, or wait for the card to be discarded before attacking them!
[*]You may find your position inland contested by the Tyrell and Lannister, so avoid heading too far from the [b]support of your ships[/b]![/list]
[u][h3]Late-Game strategy:[/h3][/u][list][*]Winning with the seventh castle is hard, but you may be able to get six castles, ensuring a strong chance of victory!
[*]You can either try to completely take over the Stark or Martell, or alternatively defend the Reach, Harrenhal and Storms End through extensive support from fortified positions.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/bc4b4e9cf7514a3755fe598b14b5fdf272ff908f.png[/img]
[h2]House Tyrell - "Growing Strong"[/h2][/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/ef409aab086d7201efc0cef8d86cac0d67b65144.png[/img]
The court may disregard you, but you will show them what the Tyrells are made of. You will not be able to recruit at first, but you have a great defensive position. Bide your time, grow strong and when the time is ripe, sieze the throne for yourself!

The Tyrells have a [b]weak early game[/b], which will blossom into a [b]strong late game[/b].

[u][h3]Early Game Strategy:[/h3][/u][list][*]Grab Oldtown as well as Prince's Pass
[*]Gather as much influence as possible to [b]climb on the King's Court [/b]and be able to recruit.
[*]Negotiate a peace with lannister. You both have an enemy to deal with first, in your case: Martell.[/list]
[u][h3]Mid-Game strategy:[/h3][/u][list][*]By nowyou should have started gathering an army. Use it to contest Starfell and the Reach.
[*]Use your 0 and 4 power cards to [b]disrupt your enemy's plans[/b].[/list]
[u][h3]Late-Game strategy:[/h3][/u][list][*]It is your time to bloom, [b]use "Ser Loras" to take a capital[/b], be it sunspear or Lannisport.
[*]If you are strong enough, you may try to wrestle control of King's Landing out of Baratheon's grasp.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/bc4b4e9cf7514a3755fe598b14b5fdf272ff908f.png[/img]
[h2]House Martell - "Unbowed, unbent, unbroken"[/h2][/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/2c56c186ebc99c4e0992cbab1b16febfe2d84d0d.png[/img]
You lack opportunities to expand, but picking a fight with you is deadly. As the Viper, you must be dissuasive before striking. Once you are ready, take over your neighbours and show your enemies why you remain Unbowed, Unbent and Unbroken!

A [b]beginner friendly [/b]House, with a [b]powerful defence [/b]and limited opportunities.

[u][h3]Early Game Strategy:[/h3][/u][list][*][b]Build a navy [/b]in the Sea of Dorne with a boat in Subspear and one in the East Summer Sea.
[*]Grab as many castles as possible.
[*]If you plan to attack the Tyrell, do it with a knight to avoid Mace Tyrell.[/list]
[u][h3]Mid-Game strategy:[/h3][/u][list][*]Try to [b]cripple the Tyrell [/b]before the grow their defenses.
[*]Propose an alliance with the Stark against Baratheon. A conjoint naval attack will open many more opportunities for you!
[*]Take Storm's End with the support of your fleet.[/list]
[u][h3]Late-Game strategy:[/h3][/u][list][*]You can [b]aim for the seventh castle [/b]victory by taking The Reach and Highgarden
[*]Use Arianne Martell to prevent cheeky attacks. Your opponents will need to commit lots of resources to take you on.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/bc4b4e9cf7514a3755fe598b14b5fdf272ff908f.png[/img]

[h2]When you play the Game of Thrones, you win or you die...[/h2]
We hope that this guide proves to be a helping hand in the battles to come, giving you a strong plan of action how to handle your diplomacy, combat and influence as you fight to become the ruler of the Seven Kingdoms!

Be sure to pick up your copy of A Game of Thrones: The Board Game - Digital Edition if you haven't already and remember to leave a review as we always appreciate every players feedback!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1075190

notes.title: That incredible Game Of Thrones board game is now on Steam
notes.content:
I’ve never really been into A Song Of Ice And Fire. Even before the internet collectively turned on the telly show in its final act, I couldn’t have told you what a Targaryen is. Even so, A Game Of Thrones: The Board Game is one of the best tabletop games I’ve ever played, its cardboard kingdoms a beloved backstabbing battleground during my uni days. Today, developers Dire Wolf Digital brought Fantasy Flight’s stellar tabletop tactics to PC – an adaptation of everything but the dagger held behind your best friend’s back.

notes.title: The Launch is here... Hold the door!
notes.content:
The launch of A Game of Thrones: The Board Game: Digital Edition has arrived. The Iron Throne is now empty and war is coming to Westeros; prepare your house for the battles ahead and fight for your rightful place on the throne!

[u][b]Pick up your copy today with a 20% discount until October 13:[/b][/u]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1075190/

[previewyoutube=1hf0TnDHge8;full][/previewyoutube]

Adapted from the physical board game, you will take control of one of six of the Great Houses of Westeros in order to fight for control of the Iron Throne. You will muster your armies, spread your influence, build and break alliances and do what you must to claim your rightful place on the throne.

To be declared the ruler of Westeros you must use diplomacy and warfare to your advantage over 10 rounds of gameplay to control as many strategic areas of the map as possible. Each round, you secretly assign one order token to each of your armies: promise support, offer peace, forge alliances, betray a vulnerable ally - a House that dares set its eyes on the Iron Throne must turn many wheels within wheels to achieve its ends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/b5599992329ebb22e82093db11c17e63f3ec8772.jpg[/img]

Not only is the digital board game based off of the second edition of the physical board game, introducing several improved rules and the sixth house, House Martell, but also includes the Vassal system from Mother of Dragons. 

Before you dive into the online multiplayer gameplay, testing your skills against up to 5 other players, try your hand at completing the tutorial to ensure you are up to speed on how to lead your armies to victory through might, skill and diplomacy! 

If you're looking to play solo, try your hands against the AI to see if you can best their wits and might. You can also fight your way through the 10 solo story challenge missions, which will have you push your strategy to its limits to find victory.

notes.content:
A game is about to begin, and you will need to either play or die… Will you gain victory through clever strategic planning or masterful diplomacy and thus spread your influence throughout the lands?
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1075190/A_Game_of_Thrones_The_Board_Game__Digital_Edition/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38086613/644cc4719806a09408c7d3ff8aa567ba64761cdb.jpg[/img]

A Game of Thrones: The Board Game – Digital Edition, the digital adaptation of its eponym board game from Fantasy Flight Games will be launching in Q3 of 2020 to Steam. Based on the best-selling A Song of Ice and Fire series of fantasy novels by George R.R. Martin, A Game of Thrones: The Board Game is one of the top-selling strategy board games and part of the 150 top-rated titles of all time on BoardGameGeek.

Take on the role of the Great Houses of the Seven Kingdoms of Westeros, as they vie for control of the Iron Throne. It takes far more than military might to win: will you take power through force, use honeyed words to coerce your way onto the throne, or rally the townsfolk to your side? All tactics are at your disposal when it comes to the Game of Thrones… who will claim that avarice of power at the end of it all, and will you be able to combat the dangers that come from the north while fighting for it?

[previewyoutube=BRgesxl-bkg;full][/previewyoutube]

A Game of Thrones: The Board Game – Digital Edition allows up to six players to compete for the Iron Throne in each match, be it all a single person against 5 AI, or 6 humans fighting for the right to sit upon the throne… With a slew of social features that will have you interacting with 	your opponents, engaging gameplay mechanics, and an ELO rating and leaderboard system, you will want to fight endlessly to claim the place at the top!

Remember… [i][b]When you play the game of thrones, you win or you die…[/b][/i]
